name: Prano Store Manager for WooCommerce
author: Ali Hp

sections.description:
Prano Store Manager for WooCommerce is a next-generation single-page application (SPA) admin dashboard built from the ground up to eliminate the friction from daily store administration.

With traditional WooCommerce workflows, store managers are forced to click through bloated page loads, endless tab hops, and slow saving interfaces. Prano Store Manager brings all essential back-office controls into one elegant, responsive, real-time dashboard.

Manage your inventory, create new products, and track customer orders in seconds with zero full-page refreshes.

🚀 Upgrade to Pro for Advanced Capabilities!

Looking to unlock variable product matrix builders, bulk operations, and advanced order quick views?
Get Prano Store Manager Pro Now!

Key Features of Free Version

  • Real-time Admin Dashboard (SPA): Navigate your store and update products instantaneously with zero page reloads.
  • Simple Product Editor: Easily modify titles, regular prices, sale prices, SKU codes, and stock levels inline.
  • Variable Product Support: Unlock inline editing of variation prices, SKUs, and stock rules directly from the main grid view.
  • Touch & Mobile Optimized: Manage your store anytime, anywhere, with a layout that functions beautifully across mobile, tablets, and desktop devices.
  • Instant Inventory Grid: Fast searching, filtering, and rapid-fire live saving indicators (with green progress flashes).
  • Simplified Product Creator: Create and publish simple products instantly on a unified, high-octane dashboard.
  • Order Lookup Engine: Review recent store order summaries, values, status logs, and general buyer details.
  • Premium Themes & Customization: Switch between ambient Dark Mode and clean Modern Light interfaces smoothly.

Pro Version Exclusive Features

Upgrade to the Pro version to experience the ultimate high-speed back-office experience for WooCommerce:

  • Cartesian Variation Matrix Compiler: Multi-dimension bulk generator that auto-compiles complex variations based on variables, parent attributes, and customized inheritance trees.
  • Interactive Expanding Drawers: Expand any variable parent product in-line to show and edit all its dynamic variation rows inside the grid.
  • Bulk Edit Actions: Select multiple products to perform bulk modifications on stock, pricing, and category assignments instantly.
  • Advanced Order Details View: Pull up complete customer billing/shipping details, interactive logs, order notes, and premium visual status selectors with no page redirects.

👉 Get started today: Upgrade to Prano Store Manager Pro
sections.installation:
1. Upload the prano-store-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress Plugins dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Access the high-speed interface by clicking on the new Store Manager sidebar menu in your WordPress Admin.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes! Prano Store Manager is a backend workspace designed strictly for store managers. It runs independently of your client-side frontend theme, page builder, or layout compiler.

Can I edit variable products in the Free version?

The Free version supports listing variable products and utilizing the interface, but editing variation structures, individual variation prices inline, and running the Cartesian Product Compiler matrix is a Premium feature reserved for the Pro Add-On.

Where can I purchase the Pro Add-On?

You can find all purchase choices, premium support, documentation, and licensing details here: Prano Store Manager Pro.
